versions.subject: Merge PR #4975 from @Murphy0801 - Add new rules related to GTFOBins
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '/python'
          - '/python2'
          - '/python3'
    - Image|contains:
          - '/python2.'  # python image is always of the form ../python3.10; ../python is just a symlink
          - '/python3.'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -c '
        - 'os.system('
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/bin/bash'
        - '/bin/dash'
        - '/bin/fish'
        - '/bin/sh'
        - '/bin/zsh'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*/python", "*/python2", "*/python3") OR Image IN ("*/python2.*", "*/python3.*") CommandLine="* -c *" CommandLine="*os.system(*" CommandLine IN ("*/bin/bash*", "*/bin/dash*", "*/bin/fish*", "*/bin/sh*", "*/bin/zsh*")
